description: Add a Hard Reset button to the Admin panel that completely resets the project to a fresh state (removes all data, agents, uploaded files, dialed logs). Requires confirmation dialog before executing.
steps: SERVER (server.js): Add POST /api/admin/hard-reset endpoint that: (1) replaces appState with createFreshState(), (2) deletes all files in uploads/lead_docs/ directory, (3) deletes all files in uploads/agent_photos/ directory, (4) saves the fresh state, (5) emits 'force-stop' to all connected clients via io.emit, (6) broadcasts fresh admin stats, (7) returns {success: true}.

ADMIN PAGE (public/admin/index.html): Add a prominent 'Hard Reset' button in the admin panel (in the button row next to 'Reset Today' and 'Clear All Numbers' buttons). Style it with a distinct dangerous appearance (red background, warning icon). On click, show a two-step confirmation: first confirm('Are you sure...'), then a second confirm with stronger wording about permanent data loss. Only if both confirmed, call the API endpoint.
ADMIN PAGE: Add the hardReset() JavaScript function that calls POST /api/admin/hard-reset, shows a toast on success, and reloads the page after a brief delay to reflect the fresh state.
acceptance_criteria: Admin panel has a visible Hard Reset button
Clicking it shows a confirmation dialog (with strong warning text)
After confirmation, all data is wiped: numbers, agents, files, logs
All connected clients get force-stop signal
Page reloads to show fresh empty state
verification: Run node -c server.js to validate server syntax
grep for 'hard-reset' in server.js and admin/index.html to confirm endpoint and button exist
findings: Button added to .btn-row div at line 472 in admin/index.html. hardReset() function added at line 879, right after clearAll(). Server endpoint already existed from FEAT-002. Verified with node -c server.js syntax check and grep confirmation.
